+GIG

Solo or party street contracts. Private site;
hostiles + systems auto-spawn on enter.

SYNTAX
  +gig · /enter · /leave · /turnin
  /invite · /join · /crew · /abandon

TOPICS
  gig/party · gig/examples

FLOW
  +gig → +gig/enter → fight/hack.
  Room clear → GO DEEPER (+gig/push · /push · Deeper).
  Last room: target → +gig/turnin.
  Paid → MARKET · HAUNTS · MAP · +gig again.

SEE ALSO: +help gig/examples, +help hack, +flow, +haunt
